## Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. (ITUB) `[Financials]`
- Brazil’s Ibovespa fell 1.06% on October 15 as the Brazilian real weakened; Itaú Unibanco was reported down 1.29% in local trading, alongside Banco do Brasil, Petrobras and Magazine Luiza. (Rio Times, Oct 16; publish time not stated)[6]

## Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR) `[Software & SaaS]`
- CNBC featured Palantir on October 15, citing second-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.94 billion, 93% year-over-year growth, net dollar retention of 157%, and 2026 revenue guidance raised from $7.19 billion in February to $8.15 billion in August. (CNBC, Oct 15 11:39 ET)[1]
- ARK Invest sold 31,432 Palantir shares valued at approximately $6.3 million on October 14; the transaction was reported on October 15, and ARK gave no explanation. [report] (Business Insider, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[9]
- A report published October 15 said Palantir’s fair-value estimate increased to $205.27 from $195.57; it cited target-price increases from Citi, UBS, Baird, Barclays, Mizuho, Northland, Phillip Securities and Deutsche Bank, with targets ranging from approximately $200 to $265. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:09 ET)[8]
- Barclays’ October 8 initiation was cited with an Overweight rating and a $265 price target; analyst Anthony Valentini said Palantir could benefit from government migration toward a unified data ecosystem. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 08:30 ET)[3]
- The same report cited Palantir’s $1.935 billion second-quarter revenue, including $809 million from U.S. government customers, and an estimated £330 million ($437 million) U.K. National Health Service contract. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 08:30 ET)[3]
- Palantir’s next expected earnings report was cited as November 2, 2026. (MarketBeat, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[7]
- A Palantir director’s Form 4 reported the sale of 5,026 shares at approximately $199 per share on October 8; the filing was updated October 16. (Stock Titan, Oct 14; updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[4]
- No after-hours or pre-market company-specific move before 02:03 ET on October 16 was identified in the available results.
